summary: Skip wake summaries for Copilot review comments whose fingerprint was already resolved (#1096).
migration_impact: No downstream repo migration. Watch CLI wiring to persist the resolved ledger lands in a follow-up PR.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the release containing #1096 ships.
2. When integrating PR watch wake, pass resolved fingerprints into build_wake_summary and call mark_resolved when threads are resolved.
agent_notes: Repeated Copilot re-review comments matching a resolved fingerprint are suppressed (suppressed_repeats count only; not actionable alone). Persist fingerprints via ResolvedLedger under .agentic/babysit/<owner>-<repo>-<pr>.resolved.json.
